sentences.en: I want to keep my room as neat as possible.
sentences.zh: 1. 我想让我的房间尽可能整洁。

sentences.en: He always keeps his room as neat as a pin.
sentences.zh: 2. 他总是把他的房间收拾得一尘不染。

sentences.en: Little as Geppetto's house was, it was neat and comfortable.
sentences.zh: 3. 虽然杰佩托的房子很小，但很整洁也很舒适。

senses.zh: 整洁的，熟练的，巧妙的，端正的，极好的，纯的
